affectedComponentIds.description: IDs of existing components that need modification. Empty if no changes are required or no existing model is present.

addComponents.description: True if any new components need to be created, or - for initial generation - if a new UI should be generated from scratch.

removeComponentIds.description: IDs of components that should be removed entirely or replaced/split. Must be disjoint from affectedComponentIds.

reasoning.description: Brief technical explanation of why components are affected, OR a user-friendly conversational reply when no generation is required.
